title: 第16章  我杀的是妖，你才是她的杀父仇人
novel_title: 人在镇魔司，红词加身只杀不渡
content_zh:
吴守信一时间僵在原地。

    张了张嘴，想问为什么。

    他眼睁睁地看着陆渊走向陈连山，又眼睁睁地看着陆渊将其杀死。

    他以为陆渊会问些什么，比如那只血妖的下落，或是陈家女子被血妖抓去了哪里。

    可陆渊什么都没问，只是报上了名字，官职，然后动手。

    杀伐果断，没有任何犹豫，甚至极其的......冷血。

    吴守信忽然觉得，自己仿佛重新认识了这位大人。

    陈连山说的那些话，那些眼泪与控诉，就好像这庭院中的砖、瓦和月光。

    存在，但不影响他做任何事。

    陈连山可不可怜？

    可怜。

    该不该杀？

    该杀！

    两件事互不干涉。

    哪怕他是被迫的，哪怕他是身不由己，哪怕他还想着救女儿。

    是妖魔，就该杀！

    “还能走吗？”陆渊在他身边停下，低头看来。

    “可以。”吴守信点头，拄着横刀站起身。

    “跟我来。”

    “大人去哪里？”

    “杀血妖。”

    吴守信脸色一变，连忙跟了上去。

    两人向后院走去，最终停在了后院的一口枯井边上。

    井边一片杂乱，看上去已经荒废了一段时间。

    吴守信看了一眼，眼中并没有异样，就好像这只是一口稀松平常的枯井。

    可在陆渊眼中，井口却笼罩着一层诡异血光。

    井下，一处石室内。

    血色符文绘制成玄奥阵法，在石室正中散发着妖异红光。

    阵法中间，一个少女被鲜血所缚。

    数道粘稠的血流宛如活物，从脚踝，腰肢，手臂，脖颈一圈圈向上蔓延。

    血流在她身上缓慢蠕动，发出黏腻的水声，有如活物。

    此刻的她，只剩一颗头颅露在外面。

    那是一张年轻的脸，双眼紧闭，浑身都在颤抖，却死死咬着牙一声不吭。

    缠绕在她身上的血流试图爬上她的脸，吞噬她最后的理智。

    血流汇聚，化作一张模糊的人脸轮廓，发出阴冷得意的笑声。
content_en:
Wu Shouxin froze in place for a moment.

    He opened his mouth and wanted to ask why.

    He watched Lu Yuan walk towards Chen Lianshan, and then watched Lu Yuan kill him.

    He thought Lu Yuan would ask something, such as the whereabouts of the blood demon, or where the Chen family girl was captured by the blood demon.

    But Lu Yuan didn't ask anything, he just reported his name and official position, and then took action.

    Killing decisively, without any hesitation, even extremely... cold-blooded.

    Wu Shouxin suddenly felt as if he had gotten to know this adult again.

    The words Chen Lianshan said, those tears and accusations were like the bricks, tiles and moonlight in this courtyard.

    It exists, but it doesn't affect what he does.

    Isn’t Chen Lianshan pitiful?

    Pitiful.

    Should he kill?

    Should be killed!

    The two things do not interfere with each other.

    Even if he was forced, even if he couldn't help himself, even if he still wanted to save his daughter.

    If he is a monster, he should be killed!

    "Can we still leave?" Lu Yuan stopped beside him and looked down.

    "Okay." Wu Shouxin nodded and stood up with a horizontal knife.

    "Follow me."

    "Where are you going, sir?"

    "Kill the blood demon."

    Wu Shouxin's expression changed and he quickly followed.

    The two walked towards the backyard and finally stopped at a dry well in the backyard.

    There was a mess around the well, and it looked like it had been abandoned for some time.

    Wu Shouxin took a look, and there was nothing strange in his eyes, as if this was just an ordinary dry well.

    But in Lu Yuan's eyes, the mouth of the well was shrouded in a strange blood light.

    Under the well, in a stone room.

    The blood-colored runes were drawn into a mysterious formation, emitting a strange red light in the center of the stone chamber.

    In the middle of the formation, a girl was bound by blood.

    Several streams of thick blood spread upward from the ankles, waist, arms, and neck like living things.

    The blood squirmed slowly on her body, making a sticky sound, like a living thing.

    At this moment, only her head was exposed.

    It was a young face, with his eyes closed tightly and his whole body trembling, but he gritted his teeth and remained silent.

    The blood that wrapped around her body tried to crawl up her face, swallowing up the last of her sanity.

    The blood flow gathered together and turned into a blurry outline of a human face, letting out a cold and proud laugh.
title_en: Chapter 16 I killed a demon, but you are her father-killing enemy.
